name: sdn-english-learning-root
description: Root package runner for SDN English Learning App

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d mongodb redis mongo-express
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix landing
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run db:up" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend-web"
